title: ScheduleCommands
description: Want to execute a command for a player, but they’re not online? No problem! ScheduleCommands will remember it and wait until the player joins your server.
body:
# ScheduleCommands

Create commands that require the player to be online, such as changing the game mode or giving an item, but without having to wait for them.
Simply use ``schedule <player> <command..>`` in the console to queue them up and sit back.
The command will be executed the next time the player joins the server.

Discord logs included!
